name: com.google.android.exoplayer2.scheduler.PlatformScheduler$PlatformSchedulerService
description: The Google ExoPlayer library runs this service when Android is ready to resume a scheduled background media task. It checks the device and network requirements, then starts the requested media service when they are met.
disableEffect: Scheduled ExoPlayer media tasks may fail to restart when their network, charging, idle, or storage requirements are met.
